$comment: What the tests' own three bases (game/tests/fixtures/bases) are, as data/genius-types.json says it of the game's: laid over the game's types for the whole test run, so a test of the rules of the three types names only these and a change to a real base's numbers is never a failing test of the engine. tedge is a weapon (a blade), tlamp a ritual item (a light set down), trun a companion (a Hunter). The tests of each effect of an item, each property of a weapon and each role's own thing put their own numbers on a fight directly.

tedge-a.name: The answer
tedge-a.text: After a parry made with it, its next blow lands twice as hard and costs it nothing.

tedge-b.name: The score
tedge-b.text: Every blow its partner takes is scored, up to three; the next blow that lands pays them back.

tedge-c.name: No guard
tedge-c.text: Every cut is half again as heavy, the third throws the foe back, and the moment to parry is halved.

always.name: Nothing comes unseen
always.text: A blow taken whole lands for a fifth less.

use.name: Set it down
use.text: It lights a circle where you stand: inside it the moment to parry is twice as long.

tlamp-a.name: Shelter
tlamp-a.text: Blows at those standing in its light land for half.

tlamp-b.name: Flame
tlamp-b.text: What stands against its partner in its light burns.

tlamp-c.name: Finder
tlamp-c.text: It is set at the foe's feet, and a guarded foe in its light is found out.
